messages.text: BL-1827 🎵 in progress — bl1754PeerQuestionInvariants invariant 1 diffs bl1754-peer-question-* entries in the shared /tmp before and after its own CLI call, so any concurrent creator (another test run, or a live role asking a peer question now BL-1754 has landed) reads as a leak and fails it at random - each call gets its own temp parent (bb -Djava.io.tmpdir=<per-call dir>) and the leak check reads only that
